“The folklore in your blood is older than language. You don’t need to speak to be heard.”

Pack Tongue (1/a Soma Break). As a bonus action, choose one ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. They have reroll the lowest die on the next Diplomacy (Presence), Intimidation (Presence) (Presence) (Presence), Stealth (Intrigue) (Intrigue) (Intrigue) (Presence), or Empathy (Presence) checks [TODO(adv-call)] they make before the start of your next turn.

Den-Sign. You can leave a small mark — scent, claw notch, fur knot — that other Furrykin and most beasts will recognize. The GM tells you what kind of marks have already been left in any area you spend 10 minutes searching.
